Zhenggang Zhang, Katherine A. Mazzio,\* Louise M. Riegger, Wolfgang Brehm, Jürgen Janek, Joachim Sann, and Philipp Adelhelm\*

Lithium thiophosphate $(\beta -\mathrm{Li}_3\mathrm{PS}_4)$ is a promising solid electrolyte (SE) for solid-state batteries (SSBs). As these redox processes can be reversible, thiophosphates can be also studied as electrode materials.
